h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Sri Ganganagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sri Ganganagar

c: Canal water turned the land around Sri Ganganagar into farmland, but the climate is still that of the Thar edge: scorching in June and close to freezing on some winter nights. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Sri Ganganagar for schools, colleges, municipal parks, cantonment and government campuses, and residential colonies. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away, and reach north Rajasthan by road.

A buyer here usually asks two questions: will the machines survive the heat, and will people use them. The first depends on materials, and our frames are galvanised pipe with roto-moulded seats and handles. The second depends on placing them where people already walk. We look at your photos, suggest a set and send a layout drawing. Our team or a dealer in north India installs after you approve.

richText.heading: Placing machines where people already walk

c: The busiest outdoor gyms sit beside a walking track or the main path through a park. Put three or four stations at one end of the track, a few metres off the path, so walkers can step aside for a set and carry on. The
work the back and shoulders, which walking leaves out.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines handle Rajasthan's summer heat?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for long outdoor use. Metal still gets hot in direct sun, so evening lighting or shade makes the gym more usable in summer.

items.q: Where should an open gym go in a park?
items.a: Close to the walking track, but a few metres off it, so users do not block walkers. We show the exact spacing on the layout drawing we send you.

items.q: Who handles installation in north Rajasthan?
items.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in north India. The method, grouted or self-standing, is chosen after we see the ground in your photos.
